name: FindAffiliates
tagline: Search 11,500+ affiliate programs by niche, commission and cookie length
description:
FindAffiliates is a searchable affiliate program directory for content creators, marketers, founders and business owners who want a faster way to discover partnerships. Instead of hunting across dozens of brand sites and networks, you browse affiliate and referral programs in one place, start with a niche, scan commission details and open program pages before spending time applying.

The directory lists more than 11,500 programs across AI tools, SaaS, SEO, marketing, e-commerce, finance, fitness, beauty and more, with categories, commission rates, cookie windows and sign-up details kept next to each listing. Filter by category or search by brand to compare options with less guesswork.

Searching is free. FindAffiliates also runs its own affiliate program paying 55% commission with a 30-day cookie for people who recommend it.

Watch out: the page says featured programs and exclusive deals are paid placements, and other listings may be paid or use partner links that earn a commission. A control on the page is labeled The AI helper, with a larger AI allowance on the paid account. Checked 2026-11-14.
